# Memory

`c.Memory` calls the API's Memory group. Get the memory usage of target hosts.

## Methods

| Method                       | Returns                              | Permission    | Description                       |
| ---------------------------- | ------------------------------------ | ------------- | --------------------------------- |
| [`Get(ctx, hostname)`](#get) | `*Response[Collection[MemoryEntry]]` | `memory:read` | Get the memory usage of the host. |

### Get

```go
func (s *MemoryService) Get(
	ctx context.Context,
	hostname string,
) (*Response[Collection[MemoryEntry]], error)
```

Get the memory usage of the host.

Reads the total, the free and the used memory, in bytes. Used is the total less
what is available, which includes the cache, as free(1) reports it.

It sends `GET /api/node/{hostname}/memory`, and needs the permission
`memory:read`.

The examples of the method's definition:

A host with 8 GiB, 2 GiB of it free, `go run memory.go get`:

```go
resp, err := c.Memory.Get(ctx, target)
```
